messages:
maya: Morning — quick async roundup for audits / KMS / IAM.
maya: KMS rotation dry-run completed in staging overnight. Import step succeeded for 8/11 keys, failed 3x with 502s from relic-service during the write. Rolled back the import after the failures to avoid partial state.
jason: Thanks. Can you paste the import job log snippet and which key versions were targeted? @priya fyi in case it's related to the ingest pipeline.
maya: Sure — log excerpt below:
```bash
kubectl logs job/kms-import-staging -n infra
[2026-03-16T07:12:03Z] INFO importing key v2026-03-16-07 -> start
[2026-03-16T07:12:09Z] ERROR http 502 from svc/relic-service: upstream reset
[2026-03-16T07:12:10Z] ERROR import failed for key v2026-03-16-07
```
maya: Targeted versions: v2026-03-16-05..v2026-03-16-07
priya: Heads-up — external auditor requested KMS event logs for the last 90 days. I prepared an export to s3://redwood-audit-exports/2026-03-16/ but need compliance sign-off before sharing. @dani can you approve the export and confirm PII scrub step?
dani: Approved for export. Please ensure any operational PII (internal usernames in payloads) are redacted. Also open a policy-as-code PR to restrict iam:CreateKey in prod to admin role boundary only.
maya: Created a tiny PR to lock down iam:CreateKey for non-admins in prod — https://git.redwood/infra/iam/PR-2345. Requesting review from @jason and @dani.
jason: I'll take a look this afternoon. Quick ask: can we add an automated guard (rbac-lint) to the pipeline to flag role bindings that grant broad serviceAccount impersonation? That would have caught the relic-ingest-sa drift last week.
sec-bot: Alert: IAM policy drift detected for service-account relic-ingest-sa — permission escalated to project:admin on 2026-03-15. Detected by policy-diff-runner.
priya: That's the SA the import job used. I'll revoke the extra perms now and audit the PR history to find who applied the change.
dani: Blocker: compliance needs to sign off before we hand logs to the auditor. @priya please add the compliance checklist to the PR and tag the compliance group. Also confirm retention policy for exported logs (default 365 days OK?)
maya: Today: 1) re-run rotation in canary (non-prod) 2) add extra tracing and retry logic to the import job 3) follow up with relic-service team about 502 spikes. No other blockers except waiting on compliance sign-off and SRE canary window.
jason: SRE okayed a canary window 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll coordinate the run and watch for downstream 502s.
priya: I'll scrub the export (remove PII fields) and upload to the auditor bucket once compliance gives the OK :thumbsup:
dani: Cool. After PR updates and scrub, ping me and I'll approve the sharing. Also assign @jason for the rbac-lint pipeline task.
maya: Thanks — will update PR and post final canary results here. :white_check_mark:
